name: 'Meiping' Bottle with Phoenix and Cloud Decor
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；13th - 14th century；Jizhou ware: ivory white stoneware with decoration reserved in the biscuit against the dark brown glaze, the reserved designs covered with clear glaze over slip-painted details. From the Jizhou kilns, near Yonghe, Ji'an, Jiangxi province.
